description: Registry and ranking gaps surfaced by non-gating holdout queries. These items are candidates for new skills, data backfill, or targeted ranking work; they are not passing release-bench expectations.

gaps.title: Climate NetCDF/xarray analysis
gaps.desired_behavior: Surface a climate or labeled-array workflow skill, or at least rank zarr-python/chunked-array tooling ahead of generic data-analysis skills.

gaps.title: Biomedical named entity recognition
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a biomedical NER or information-extraction skill rather than literature-search or writing skills.

gaps.title: General object detection / YOLO
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a general object-detection skill when available; avoid presenting bioimage-only or adverse-event skills as a confident match.

gaps.title: Neuroimaging NIfTI / MRI / fMRI analysis
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a neuroimaging/NIfTI skill when one is present, or clearly report a registry gap instead of generic data-analysis matches.

gaps.title: Metabolomics LC-MS pathway enrichment
gaps.desired_behavior: Prefer a metabolomics-specific skill if added; meanwhile keep broad multi-omics planning ahead of MS/MS prediction or RNA-seq-only enrichment pages.

gaps.title: GWAS fine-mapping and colocalization
query_examples: GWAS summary statistics fine mapping colocalization
genome wide association summary stats fine mapping
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a GWAS fine-mapping, coloc, or summary-statistics genetics skill when available; avoid broad clinical-statistics pages or LLM fine-tuning skills.

gaps.title: Microbiome QIIME2 differential abundance
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a microbiome differential-abundance skill for QIIME2/ANCOM/LEfSe/ALDEx2 workflows when available; avoid RNA-seq differential-expression or clinical differential-diagnosis false positives.

gaps.title: ELISA standard-curve analysis
query_examples: enzyme linked immunosorbent assay standard curve
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend an ELISA/immunoassay standard-curve analysis skill when available; avoid decision-curve, decision-tree, or generic spreadsheet-analysis false positives.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user with ELISA plate absorbance and standards needs concentration interpolation and 4PL/5PL curve fitting, not a clinical decision-curve or generic spreadsheet helper.
avoid_false_positives: Decision-curve or decision-tree skills evaluate clinical models; they do not fit ELISA standard curves.
Generic spreadsheet analysis can be a manual workaround, but it is not a validated immunoassay quantification workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts standard concentrations and absorbance/OD values.
Fits 4PL or 5PL standard curves and reports sample concentration interpolation.
Explains dilution factors, replicate handling, outlier flags, and curve-fit diagnostics.

gaps.title: Western blot densitometry quantification
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a western blot/immunoblot densitometry analysis skill when available; avoid figure-legend, RNA-seq transcript-quantification, or generic bioinformatics false positives.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user needs lane/band intensity measurement and normalization to loading controls, not RNA-seq transcript quantification or manuscript figure text.
avoid_false_positives: RNA-seq quantification skills operate on sequencing reads or count matrices, not gel/blot images.
Figure-legend or image-caption skills can describe a blot but do not quantify band intensity.
acceptance_criteria: Handles band ROI intensity, background subtraction, and loading-control normalization.
Supports replicate summaries and fold-change reporting.
States image quality assumptions such as non-saturated bands and comparable exposure.

gaps.title: qPCR Ct/ddCt expression analysis
query_examples: qPCR Ct ddCt gene expression analysis
qPCR Ct values relative expression normalization
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a qPCR Ct/ddCt expression-analysis skill when available; keep qPCR primer-design skills for primer design queries, and avoid generic expression-matrix or RNA-seq differential-expression false positives.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user has Ct values and needs delta-delta Ct relative expression, not primer design or RNA-seq differential-expression analysis.
avoid_false_positives: qPCR primer-design skills help before the experiment; they do not analyze Ct tables.
RNA-seq differential-expression skills assume count matrices and statistical models, not Ct normalization.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts target/reference gene Ct tables with control and treatment groups.
Computes delta Ct, delta-delta Ct, fold change, and replicate summaries.
Flags missing reference genes, high Ct values, and inconsistent technical replicates.

gaps.title: Immunofluorescence colocalization quantification
query_examples: fluorescence microscopy Pearson Manders colocalization analysis
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend an immunofluorescence colocalization analysis skill with Pearson, Manders, and channel-overlap quantification when available; keep generic Fiji/scikit-image skills for broad microscopy processing queries and avoid electron-microscopy false positives.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user needs channel colocalization coefficients and thresholding guidance, not broad microscopy viewing or electron-microscopy database search.
avoid_false_positives: Generic Fiji/scikit-image skills can process images but do not guarantee Pearson/Manders colocalization workflow decisions.
Electron-microscopy skills target EM density/map retrieval, not fluorescence channel overlap quantification.
acceptance_criteria: Supports Pearson, Manders, and thresholded overlap metrics.
Explains channel preprocessing, background subtraction, ROI selection, and threshold choices.
Reports per-image/per-cell summaries with reproducible parameters.

gaps.title: Luciferase reporter assay normalization
query_examples: luciferase reporter assay normalization dual luciferase
dual luciferase reporter assay firefly renilla normalization
reporter gene assay luciferase activity normalization
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a luciferase reporter-assay analysis skill with Firefly/Renilla normalization and reporter activity quantification when available; avoid drug bioactivity, expression-matrix normalization, or transcriptome-planning false positives.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user has Firefly/Renilla luminescence readings and needs reporter-activity normalization, not drug bioactivity scoring or expression-matrix normalization.
avoid_false_positives: Bioactivity skills may analyze compound response but do not normalize dual-luciferase reporter controls.
Expression-matrix normalization skills operate on gene/protein matrices, not paired Firefly/Renilla assay readings.
acceptance_criteria: Accepts Firefly and Renilla readings with blank/control groups.
Computes normalized reporter activity, fold change, and replicate summaries.
Explains blank subtraction, transfection-control normalization, and outlier handling.

gaps.title: CyTOF / mass cytometry analysis
query_examples: CyTOF mass cytometry clustering gating analysis
mass cytometry arcsinh transformation FlowSOM clustering
CyTOF marker expression cell population abundance analysis
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a CyTOF/mass-cytometry analysis skill when available; keep FCS parsing and generic clustering skills as weak references rather than complete substitutes.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user with CyTOF marker-intensity data needs mass-cytometry preprocessing, clustering, gating, and population abundance interpretation, not just FCS file parsing or generic clustering.
avoid_false_positives: flowio/flow cytometry parsing skills can read FCS-like data but do not provide CyTOF-specific transformation, clustering, marker annotation, or abundance interpretation.
Generic clustering skills can cluster matrices but do not explain CyTOF marker panels, arcsinh transformation, batch effects, or cell-population labeling.
acceptance_criteria: Supports CyTOF or mass-cytometry marker-intensity matrices with arcsinh/cofactor transformation.
Provides clustering or gating workflows such as FlowSOM/Phenograph-style population discovery.
Reports marker-based population labels, abundance summaries, and reproducible preprocessing parameters.

gaps.title: ChIP-seq peak calling and differential binding
query_examples: ChIP-seq MACS2 peak calling differential binding DiffBind
chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing peak calling MACS2
gaps.desired_behavior: Recommend a ChIP-seq peak-calling and differential-binding skill when available; keep ATAC-seq peak-calling skills as weak references rather than complete substitutes.
gaps.user_facing_problem: A user with ChIP-seq aligned reads needs immunoprecipitation peak calling, control/input handling, annotation, and differential binding analysis, not ATAC-seq accessibility analysis.
avoid_false_positives: ATAC-seq peak-calling skills target open-chromatin accessibility and ATAC-specific parameters, not ChIP immunoprecipitation controls.
Generic differential-expression skills compare expression matrices, not genomic binding peaks or occupancy changes.
acceptance_criteria: Supports ChIP-seq peak calling with input/control handling and MACS2/MACS3-style parameters.
Annotates peaks to genes or genomic features and reports QC such as FRiP or peak counts.
Supports differential binding workflows such as DiffBind-style contrasts with reproducible design metadata.
